# Nadwa Healthcare (NHC)

> Nadwa Healthcare (NHC) is an ethical, accredited international medical tourism facilitation organization headquartered in New Delhi, India. NHC provides overseas patients—principally from the Middle East (GCC), Central Asia (CIS), Africa, and Western nations—with 100% free official hospital opinions, itemized surgery cost estimates, and urgent Indian Medical Visa Invitation Letters (VIL) within 24 to 48 hours with zero facilitation or agency service fees.

## Core Specialties

- [Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/cardiology): Minimally invasive CABG, TAVR, pediatric cardiac surgery, and robotic heart valve repair at JCI-accredited cardiac centers.
- [Oncology & Cancer Care](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/cancer-treatment): Advanced medical, surgical, and radiation oncology including Proton Therapy, CyberKnife, bone marrow transplant, and CAR-T cell immunotherapy.
- [Orthopedics & Joint Replacement](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/orthopedics): Robotic knee replacement (Mako / Rosa), total hip arthroplasty, and complex revision joint surgeries.
- [Neurosurgery & Spine](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/neurosurgery): Minimally invasive endoscopic spine surgery, deep brain stimulation (DBS), and robotic cranial tumor resections.
- [Kidney & Urology](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/kidney-urology): Robotic kidney transplants, laser prostatectomies (HoLEP), and complex renal reconstruction.
- [Liver Transplant & Gastroenterology](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/liver-transplant): Living-donor adult and pediatric liver transplantation with >95% success rates at dedicated quaternary liver units.
- [IVF & Fertility Treatments](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/ivf-fertility): Advanced assisted reproductive technologies, ICSI, PGT-A genetic screening, and donor programs.
- [Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/cosmetic-surgery): Aesthetic surgery, reconstructive microsurgery, and burn management.
- [Dental Treatment](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/treatments/dental): All-on-4 / All-on-6 dental implants, full-mouth rehabilitation, and smile design.

## Partner Hospitals in Delhi NCR

- [Medanta – The Medicity, Gurugram](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/medanta-the-medicity): 1,250+ bed quaternary care flagship institution featuring robotic surgical suites and multi-organ transplant programs.
- [Fortis Escorts Heart Institute, New Delhi](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/fortis-escorts-heart-institute): Internationally renowned cardiac institute with 310+ beds and over 100,000 successful cardiac interventions.
- [Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals, New Delhi](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/indraprastha-apollo-hospitals): India's first JCI-accredited tertiary care center with 710+ beds covering 52 clinical disciplines.
- [Fortis Memorial Research Institute (FMRI), Gurugram](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/fortis-memorial-research-institute): Next-generation quaternary hospital with 1,000 beds, Elekta Versa HD linear accelerators, and da Vinci Xi robotics.
- [Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/max-super-speciality-hospital-saket): Premier 530+ bed quaternary referral hospital with Asia's first BrainSUITE intra-operative MRI.
- [Artemis Hospital, Gurugram](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/artemis-hospital-gurugram): First JCI and NABH-accredited hospital in Gurugram with 400+ beds and comprehensive cancer institute.
- [Sanar International Hospital, Gurugram](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/sanar-international-hospital): Boutique 130-bed quaternary surgical center specializing in complex robotic surgeries and organ transplants.
- [Manipal Hospital, Dwarka](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/manipal-hospital-dwarka): 380-bed modern tertiary institution located 15 minutes from Indira Gandhi International Airport.
- [Amrita Hospital, Faridabad](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/amrita-hospital-faridabad): Mega 2,600-bed healthcare facility with India's largest private research and clinical trial laboratories.
- [Jaypee Hospital, Noida](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/hospitals/jaypee-hospital-noida): 525-bed tertiary care hospital with leading liver, kidney, and bone marrow transplant units.

## Top Specialist Doctors

- [Dr. Naresh Trehan](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-naresh-trehan): Chairman & Chief Cardiac Surgeon at Medanta; pioneer of minimally invasive cardiac surgery with 48,000+ open heart procedures.
- [Dr. Ashok Seth](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-ashok-seth): Chairman of Fortis Escorts Heart Institute; global pioneer in interventional cardiology and transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR).
- [Dr. Ashok Rajgopal](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-ashok-rajgopal): Group Chairman of Orthopaedics at Medanta; internationally acclaimed robotic knee surgeon with 35,000+ joint arthroplasties.
- [Dr. Arvinder Soin](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-arvinder-soin): Chairman of Liver Transplantation at Medanta; pioneer of living donor liver transplantation in India with 4,000+ transplants.
- [Dr. Subhash Gupta](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-subhash-gupta): Chairman of Centre for Liver & Biliary Sciences at Max Super Speciality Hospital.
- [Dr. Sandeep Vaishya](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-sandeep-vaishya): Executive Director of Neurosurgery at Fortis Memorial Research Institute; renowned gamma knife and skull base surgeon.
- [Dr. Anant Kumar](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-anant-kumar): Chairman of Urology & Kidney Transplantation at Max Saket; leading robotic urological surgeon with 3,500+ transplants.
- [Dr. Harit Chaturvedi](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-harit-chaturvedi): Chairperson of Max Institute of Cancer Care; surgical oncologist with 30+ years of oncology leadership.
- [Dr. Vinod Raina](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-vinod-raina): Executive Director of Medical Oncology at Fortis Memorial Research Institute; performed India's first autologous peripheral stem cell transplant.
- [Dr. Rajesh Ahlawat](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/doctors/dr-rajesh-ahlawat): Group Chairman of Kidney & Urology at Medanta; co-developer of robotic kidney transplantation with hypothermic perfusion.

## Patient Services & Contact

- [Free Medical Opinions & Cost Estimates](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/services): Zero-fee second opinions and treatment plan reviews directly from hospital department heads within 24 hours.
- [Indian Medical Visa Assistance](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/services): Official hospital Medical Visa Invitation Letters (VIL) issued for patient and up to two attendants in 24–48 hours at zero cost.
- [Concierge Support](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/services): Complimentary airport pickup, dedicated multi-lingual medical interpreters (Arabic, French, Russian), foreign exchange, local SIM cards, and guest house reservations.
- [Patient Testimonials](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/patient-stories): Documented case studies and recovery journeys of international patients treated across Delhi NCR.
- [Medical Travel Blog](https://www.nadwahealthcare.com/blog): Procedure cost breakdowns, treatment guidelines, and recovery protocols.
